text:
incident-bot: PAGE: BeaconPay (single-tenant) p99 tail latency breach detected in us-west-2 - streaming stalls observed, current p99 = 5.6s (> SLO 3s). Paging on-call @sarah-oc :rotating_light:

sarah-oc: Acked. jumping in. any immediate mitigation we can enact while we triage?

ops-bot: Alert details: metric=service.latency.p99, window=5m, value=5.6, threshold=3.0. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/latency/tenant?orgId=1&tenant=BeaconPay

josh-rt: I'm on call too, reassign to me if you need overnight follow-up @sarah-oc. Quick checks: is this only streaming endpoints or also non-streaming?

beacon-eng: We're seeing a lot of client-side timeouts on streaming sessions starting ~12:14 UTC. Non-streaming (batch) endpoints look okay. Logs show a lot of stalled frames and reconnects.

lee-sre: Looks like streaming tail amplification. p95 jumped from 1.1s -> 1.9s; p99 from 2.8s -> 5.6s in the last 10m. I can see a burst of long prefix requests + many concurrent sessions: concurrency ~1.6x baseline.

emily-pm: Customer impact: payments UI freezes, some webhooks delayed. BeaconPay reports increased error rates for streaming web client, ~3% dropouts.

josh-rt: Ok. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) temporarily route BeaconPay traffic to the lower-latency model variant (quantized-optim) 2) increase dedicated pool capacity (add one GPU node) 3) enable degraded streaming mode (no chunking wait) 4) evict long KV cache entries for their tenant. I'll kick off steps 1+2 now.

sarah-oc: +1 to quick fallback to quantized-optim. Runbook: /runbooks/latency-tail (see section "single-tenant streaming stalls").

josh-rt: Rolling traffic policy update: `redwoodctl route update --tenant BeaconPay --model quantized-optim --weight 100`

ops-bot: Command executed: `route update job started` (job id: rj-4589). Expect propagation ~30s.

josh-rt: Scaling pool: `infractl scale dedicated-pool beacongw-pool +1` -> request submitted.

ops-bot: Scale job accepted (job id: scale-7721). Monitoring node boot and agent registration.

lee-sre: While nodes come up, try evicting long prefix entries: `kvstore evict --tenant BeaconPay --older-than 1h` — that should reduce KV cache thrash.

josh-rt: Running eviction now. `kvctl evict --tenant BeaconPay --max-age 3600` -> done. A few big entries removed (owner: session-prefix-uuid...).

beacon-eng: Noted. After eviction we saw a small improvement in streaming throughput on client side.

ops-bot: Model routing update propagated. New traffic -> quantized-optim.

josh-rt: After fallback, p95=1.4s, p99=3.2s (improved but still slightly > SLO). Scaling completed - new node joined serving pool.

lee-sre: Great. I'm seeing a drop in tail stalls but a residual bump at very long prefixes. Could be prompt fanout combined with high concurrency. Any unusual prompts from BeaconPay?

beacon-eng: We did roll a new feature that sends long policy prompts (~12k chars) to the streaming endpoint starting 12:10 UTC. Could be correlated. We'll toggle feature off if needed.

emily-pm: Please coordinate with BeaconPay to degrade prompt size while we stabilize.

josh-rt: Can we enable streaming degrade flag: `runtime update --tenant BeaconPay --streaming-mode reduced-latency` (drops prefetch, shorter chunk window)?

ops-bot: Runtime update applied. Degraded streaming enabled for BeaconPay.

lee-sre: After streaming degrade + eviction + fallback + scale: p95=1.2s, p99=2.6s. Back under SLO for last 3m. I'll watch for regressions.

sarah-oc: Handing off to @josh-rt for post-incident tracking and follow-up with BeaconPay. Josh please create an incident ticket and schedule a re-run of the load test with the long prompts (owner: beacon-eng).

josh-rt: Will do. Creating INC ticket now and posting runbook checklist. Key action items: 1) collaborate with BeaconPay to throttle long prompts / add client-side length guard 2) add auto-evict rule for KV entries >30m for heavy tenants 3) evaluate prefix-aware batching to avoid fanout stalls 4) schedule proactive canary that includes long-prompt scenarios.

beacon-eng: We'll disable the new feature for now and open a patch to chunk prompts. Thanks for quick help.

sarah-oc: Nice mitigation. Leaving channel but reachable if needed.

josh-rt: I'll take overnight watch, create ticket, and draft postmortem. Posting initial incident timeline and metrics to ticket.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-458 (owner=josh-rt). Postmortem meeting tentative tomorrow 16:00 UTC.

lee-sre: Adding a small follow-up note: consider adding a streaming SLO breaker to route to non-streaming path automatically after N retries to avoid user-facing stalls.

josh-rt: Noted. I'll include in the action list. Closing this page for active mitigation; monitoring open. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: BeaconPay p99 back under SLO for 10m. If reoccurs, page on-call.

beacon-eng: Thanks team. We'll coordinate the prompt change and follow up after the patch.

josh-rt: Final metrics snapshot: p95=1.1s, p99=2.4s, streaming error-rate down to 0.4%. Filing postmortem draft now.
